carrier: dry air; fixed density and viscosity inputs
humidity: No humidity or heat-transport equation. No evaporation or condensation. Experimental humidity is unavailable and not silently assigned a measured value.
liquid: pure water; no surfactant, dissolved solute or charge
shape: axisymmetric spheroid with one volume-preserving coordinate
interface: immobile no-slip gas boundary for each lookup calculation; reduced liquid shape dynamics separately
thermal: isothermal; surface tension fixed at nominal20C
turbulence: resolved3D unsteadiness with fixed Smagorinsky closure, not fully resolved DNS
transport: No aerosols, particle capture, coalescence, adsorption or chemical reaction in this increment
sampling: Last half of each gas record; four time blocks describe variability without assuming statistical independence
uncertainty: Numerical controls and one-at-a-time input perturbations; no joint posterior or total confidence interval
mass: Exact geometric liquid volume; small nonconservative numerical leakage at interpolated gas walls is explicitly measured in a separate ledger test
energy: Liquid reduced-model work/dissipation balance; not a global two-phase energy balance
